runs.text: Stephan Bodzin live for Cercle at Piz Gloria, Switzerland

attributedDescription.content:
Stephan Bodzin playing his unique live set 10,000 feet high in the mountains at Schilthorn Piz Gloria for Cercle.

☞ Join Cercle Odyssey immersive events: https://Cercle.lnk.to/CercleOdysseyID
☞ Join our next events: https://Cercle.lnk.to/Members
☞ Listen to our playlists, tracks & sets: https://Cercle.lnk.to/Playlists

☞ Stephan Bodzin

‪@STEPHANBODZINofficial‬ 
  / stephanbodzin  
  / stephanbodzinofficial  
http://www.stephanbodzin.de/
____

46°33'26.9"N 7°50'04.6"E

Video credits:

Artist: Stephan Bodzin
Venue: Schilthorn Piz Gloria (https://www.schilthorn.ch/)
Produced by Cercle
Founder & artistic director: Derek Barbolla
Film directed by: Pol Souchier & Derek Barbolla
Music Curation by: Philippe Tuchmann
Directors of photography: Anatole Vaillant, Houssam Omar, Haytham Omar.
Drone: Cercle / Anatole Vaillant
Sound Engineer: Vincent Mathieu & Pierre Jean Lorteau assisted by Aurélien Moisan

Special thanks to Piz Gloria team for all their help & their warm welcome.
Also to Galerie Saint-Joseph.
